officialSummary: As part of the ongoing effort towards consolidation of various instructions issued from time to time, the Reserve Bank has undertaken a review of the extant guidelines relating to Priority Sector Lending (PSL) and proposes to issue Directions on the subject RE-wise. 2. Accordingly, the following draft Directions are being placed on the website for public comments: Reserve Bank of India (Commercial Banks – Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Small Finance Banks – Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Local Area Banks – Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Regional Rural Banks – Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2026 Reserve Bank of India (Urban Co-operative Banks – Priority Sector Lending – Targets and Classification) Directions, 2026 3. Further, instructions which have not been included in the consolidated draft Directions would be repealed consequent to the issuance of the Directions. The same will be notified separately. 4. The comments / feedback may be submitted on or before November 26, 2026 , through the following channels: i. The ‘ Connect 2 Regulate ’ section on the website by following the corresponding hyperlink provided against each document in the page where they are hosted. or ii. by e-mail with the subject line ‘Feedback on [full name of the draft Direction / (including the type of Regulated Entity)]’. (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1447
title: Consolidation of Instructions Related to Priority Sector Lending – Drafts for Comments

officialSummary: The Reserve Bank of India issued Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 to The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra vide Directive No. NGP.DOS.SSM3.No.S611/5-04-166/2025-2026 dated November 06, 2025, for a period of six months up to close of business on May 07, 2026, which was last extended up to the close of business on November 07, 2026, vide Directive No. DOR.MON/D-30/12-22-635/2026-27 dated July 31, 2026. The Reserve Bank of India is satisfied that in the public interest, it is necessary to further extend the period of operation of the Directive beyond close of business on November 07, 2026. 2. Accordingly, the Reserve Bank of India, in the exercise of powers vested in it under sub-section (1) of Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949, hereby extends the Directive for a further period of three months from close of business on November 07, 2026, to close of business on February 07, 2027, subject to review. 3. The aforesaid extension and /or modification by the Reserve Bank of India should not per se be construed to imply that the Reserve Bank of India is satisfied with the financial position of the bank. 4. Other terms and conditions of the Directive under reference, shall remain unchanged. (Brij Raj) Chief General Manager Press Release: 2026-2027/1446
title: Directions under Section 35A read with Section 56 of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949 – The Pusad Urban Co-operative Bank Ltd., Pusad, Dist. Yavatmal, Maharashtra – Extension of Period
